fixtures.preview: A tough trip to fifth-placed Chelsea with United 16th and manager Michael Carrick's future in doubt (11:30pm Sat 31 Oct Sydney).
talking_points: United are 16th on 7 points, just above the drop zone, according to the Sky Sports table updated after Sunday's games.

ESPN reports Carrick left Carrington after talks with Omar Berrada and Jason Wilcox about his future; the club hasn't said whether he stays, and clarity is expected only once players return to training.
United have reportedly won just two of 12 games in all competitions, their worst start since 1986.
Chelsea are fifth on 13 points; team news for both sides isn't confirmed.

fixtures.preview: Matchday 4 of the Champions League league phase brings Roma to Old Trafford (7am Wed 4 Nov Sydney).
A Sunday 4:30pm UK home game against Villa, who beat Manchester City 2-1 on Saturday.
The trip to Anfield is set for Sunday 22 November at 4:30pm UK time.
Matchday 5 in Lisbon, listed by UEFA at 21:00 CET (7am Thu 26 Nov Sydney).
A 5pm Halloween game in round 3 at AAMI Park, with Sydney fresh from their first win of the season.
talking_points: Sydney came from behind to beat Adelaide United 2-1, with Rhys Youlley and Oriola Sunday scoring, and coach Kisnorbo praised the team's character.
That followed a 0-0 draw with Western Sydney in round 1.
City are winless after two games, including a 1-1 Melbourne Derby, per last run's reporting.
A March 2026 preview noted Sydney hadn't beaten City in the league since December 2022; team news isn't published yet.
